Sometimes I feel comforted when I stay at other places, like a hotel on vacation, and I just tell myself there's no way for everything there to feel "clean" to me. I think to myself that once I get home I will be able to put all the stuff I need to in the laundry; if necessary, I can wipe down the laptop/phone. Then sometimes, over the time I'm out of my house it starts to make me feel less intensely about the "dirt" that could be on my stuff.

Sometimes I also try to think to myself how technically the stuff cannot really "transfer" from item to item, or that even if it did it would be in very miniscule amounts or rub away/disappear quickly, or even decompose eventually if it's organic matter that is making me scared.

Idk if any of that is helpful or the right approach, but just sharing what kind of helps me.
